definitions.explanation: A collection of similar things or beings gathered together.
Used as a suffix to indicate a group or category.

examples.notes: [Note: 群れ is also read むれ]

examples.japanese: {実験|じっけん}{群|ぐん}と{対照|たいしょう}{群|ぐん}
この{島|しま}には{希少|きしょう}な{植物|しょくぶつ}{群|ぐん}が{生息|せいそく}しており、{保護|ほご}{区域|くいき}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: Rare plant groups inhabit this island, which has been designated as a protected area.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}{群|ぐん}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: A group of buildings stands in a row.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}{群|ぐん}ごとにデータを{分析|ぶんせき}する。
examples.english: To analyze data by age group.

notes:
{群|ぐん} indicates a group or collection.

AS SUFFIX:
- {実験|じっけん}{群|ぐん} (experimental group)
- {対照|たいしょう}{群|ぐん} (control group)
- {年齢|ねんれい}{群|ぐん} (age group)
- {血液|けつえき}{型|がた}{群|ぐん} (blood type group)

RELATED WORDS:
- {群|ぐん}: group (formal/scientific)
- {群|む}れ: flock, herd, group (general)
- グループ: group (loanword)

NOTE: {群|ぐん} is often used in scientific or technical contexts.
